DISCORDBOT_UPDATE_GUILD_MEMBER.description: Updates a guild member's attributes including nickname, roles, voice state, timeout status, and flags. Only provided fields will be updated. Requires appropriate permissions for each operation.

deaf.description: Whether to server-deafen the member in voice channels. Requires DEAFEN_MEMBERS permission.

mute.description: Whether to server-mute the member in voice channels. Requires MUTE_MEMBERS permission.

nick.description: New nickname for the guild member. Set to empty string to remove. Maximum 32 characters.

flags.description: Guild member flags represented as a bit set integer.

roles.description: Array of role IDs to assign to the member. Replaces all current roles except @everyone.

user_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the Discord user whose guild member attributes are being updated.

guild_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the Discord guild where the member belongs.

channel_id.description: Voice channel ID to move the member to. Set to null to disconnect from voice.

communication_disabled_until.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the user's timeout expires. Max 28 days from now. Set to null to remove timeout.

DISCORDBOT_ADD_GUILD_MEMBER_ROLE.description: Assigns a role to a guild member. Requires MANAGE_ROLES permission and the role must be lower in hierarchy than the bot's highest role. Returns 204 on success.

role_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the Discord role to be assigned to the member.

user_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the Discord user to whom the role will be added.

guild_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the Discord guild where the member and role exist.

DISCORDBOT_UPDATE_GUILD_ROLE.description: Updates a Discord guild role's attributes (name, permissions, color, etc.). Requires MANAGE_ROLES permission. Unspecified attributes remain unchanged. The icon and unicode_emoji fields are mutually exclusive.

icon.description: New role icon as base64 encoded image data. Mutually exclusive with unicode_emoji.

name.description: New name for the role (max 100 characters).

color.description: New color as an integer representation of a hex code (0 for no color).

hoist.description: Whether to display the role separately in the member list.

role_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the role to be updated.

guild_id.description: The unique identifier (snowflake ID) of the guild containing the role.

mentionable.description: Whether to allow anyone to mention this role.

permissions.description: Bitwise value for new role permissions.

unicode_emoji.description: New unicode emoji for the role's icon. Mutually exclusive with icon. Requires ROLE_ICONS guild feature.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_SHOPPING.description: Search for products with advanced price filtering, location targeting, and deal discovery. This tool provides comprehensive product search with price range filtering, geographic targeting for local retailers, sorting by price (low to high, high to low), and filtering for free shipping or sale items. Perfect for product research, price comparison, finding deals, and discovering where to buy items. Returns product details, prices, availability, seller information, and reviews. Examples: query="gaming laptop" + min_price=800 + max_price=1500 + sort_by=1 query="running shoes" + location="Seattle, WA" + free_shipping=True query="coffee maker" + on_sale=True + gl="us"

gl.description: Country code for shopping region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

query.description: Product search query. Use anything you would search for on Google Shopping.

on_sale.description: Filter to show only products that are currently on sale.

sort_by.description: Sort products by price. 1 = Price: low to high, 2 = Price: high to low.

location.description: Geographic location for shopping search. Use city names for best results. Helps find local retailers and pricing.

max_price.description: Maximum price filter in USD (integer value). Only show products at or below this price.

min_price.description: Minimum price filter in USD (integer value). Only show products at or above this price.

free_shipping.description: Filter to show only products with free shipping.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_AMAZON.description: Search Amazon for products across different country marketplaces. This tool searches Amazon's product catalog with support for multiple international Amazon domains/marketplaces. Each domain serves a different country with local pricing, currency, shipping options, and product availability. Perfect for product research, international price comparison, and finding products available in specific countries. Returns product details, pricing in local currency, ratings, reviews, and seller information. Examples: query="gaming laptop" + amazon_domain="amazon.com" for US marketplace query="coffee maker" + amazon_domain="amazon.de" for German marketplace query="iPhone 15" + amazon_domain="amazon.co.uk" for UK marketplace with GBP pricing

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Each page typically contains ~20 results. Use this to retrieve additional pages of results beyond the first page.

query.description: Product search query for Amazon. Use natural language or specific product names.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain based on country. Defaults to amazon.com. Different domains serve different countries and currencies.
